name: KueskiPay Gateway
author: kueski

sections.description:
Choose how many fortnights to pay with Kueski Pay

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or newer.
  • WooCommerce 7.6 or newer.
  • PHP 7.4 or newer is recommended.

External services

This plugin connects to services operated by Kueski (Kueski, S.A.P.I. de C.V., SOFOM, E.N.R.) to show promotional widgets and to create, check and refund payments. The payment connections are required for the gateway to work. They are made only after you activate the plugin and enter your Kueski API key.

When Sandbox mode is enabled, the payment connections go to a Kueski test environment instead of api.kueskipay.com.

Kueski privacy notices:

  • Customers and users: https://preguntas.frecuentes.kueski.com/hc/es/articles/12385430001563-Aviso-de-privacidad-integral-para-clientes-y-usuarios-de-Kueski-S-A-P-I-de-C-V-SOFOM-E-N-R
  • Merchants (commercial allies): https://preguntas.frecuentes.kueski.com/hc/es/articles/12385599806747-PRIVACY-NOTICE-FOR-THIRD-PARTIES-AND-COMMERCIAL-ALLIES-OF-KUESKI-SAPI-DE-CV-SOFOM-ENR

Kueski Pay widgets (cdn.kueskipay.com)

  • What it is: the script https://cdn.kueskipay.com/widgets.js, which shows the Kueski Pay installment widget on product and cart pages.
  • When: the script is loaded on storefront pages.
  • Data sent: your Kueski public API key, whether Sandbox mode is on, the integration name (woocommerce) and the plugin version. The visitor’s browser also sends its usual request data (IP address, User-Agent) to the CDN.
  • Code: public/class-wc-kueski-gateway-public.php (kueski_widget_enqueue_scripts(), add_widget_init()).

Kueski Payments API (api.kueskipay.com)

  • What it is: the Kueski Payments API, which the gateway uses to create, check and refund Kueski Pay payments.
  • When: only after you activate the plugin and enter your Kueski API key. The plugin contacts it to check that the gateway is available at checkout, when a customer places an order with Kueski Pay, when the customer returns to the store from Kueski, while orders wait for Kueski to confirm their payment, when an admin refunds an order, and when someone checks the plugin’s monitoring endpoint on your store.
  • Data sent:
    • With every request: your Kueski API key (except refunds, see below), the customer’s browser User-Agent, whether the request comes from web or mobile, and the WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP and plugin versions.
    • To create a payment: the order ID and description, order total and currency, each item (name, description, SKU or WC-<product ID> when the product has none, quantity, price), the shipping address (first and last name, street, interior, city, state, postcode, country), the billing email and phone number, and the URLs Kueski returns the customer to.
    • To check a payment: its Kueski payment ID.
    • To refund a payment: its Kueski payment ID, the refund amount, currency and reason, a reference for the refund, and a token signed with your private key. The private key itself is never sent.
  • Code: includes/class-wc-kueski-gateway-api.php.
